entries.name: sglang
entries.notes: QSA, hyper-connections, PLE, NVFP4 MoE scale semantics and the GDN causal conv1d (Triton prefill and update); nothing is vendored (math reference only).

entries.name: DICE-8B
entries.notes: SelfTune ST4 S3c: family sdar's forward (block-causal GQA attention, RMSNorm, RoPE, SiLU MLP) and the BF16 rounding points its kernels follow; nothing is vendored (math reference only).

entries.name: transformers
entries.notes: Inkling 2 Mini S7 (tasks/inkling-spec.md 3.6): the vision tower (Inkling2VisionModel: patch embedding, interpolated position grid, class token, axial 2D RoPE, layer-scale encoder, merger) the kernels follow; nothing is vendored (math reference only).

entries.name: sglang-upstream
entries.notes: Inkling 2 Mini S9 (tasks/inkling-spec.md 3.5): the block drafter (Inkling2ForConditionalGenerationMTP on DSparkDraftModel/DFlashDraftModel: tap mix, context K/V, block attention, Markov rnn_hidden head, greedy chain verify) that executor/ref/inkling/drafter_ref.h and the drafter kernels follow; nothing is vendored (math reference only). Distinct from the lovedheart-fork entry `sglang`.

entries.name: flash-linear-attention
entries.revision: sglang d4689328ed1de81d5ce491f52b93f6edb77e0ffe (the adapted copy names no upstream commit)
entries.notes: Gated delta rule (GDN): gating, L2 norm and the chunk-64 WY prefill (cumsum, fused kkt + solve, wy_fast, chunk_delta_h, chunk_o); authors Songlin Yang, Yu Zhang. Math reference only.

entries.name: flashinfer
entries.notes: NVFP4 activation quantizer (cvt_warp_fp16_to_fp4, fast-math path), linear-layout E2M1/UFP8 dequant (E2M1AndUFP8SFScaleToFloatV2) and the fused-MoE activation/re-quantization order. quantization_utils.cuh and fp4Op.cpp are NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM code (Apache-2.0) carried inside FlashInfer under csrc/nv_internal/tensorrt_llm; the MoE file is TensorRT-LLM's CUTLASS MoE backend as adapted in FlashInfer. The GDN decode step: gated_delta_rule_decode_pretranspose (gdn_decode.py) and its BF16-state MTP-ILP4 CuTe DSL kernel (gdn_decode_bf16_state.py). Math reference only; nothing is vendored.

entries.name: flashinfer-vendored
entries.revision: flashinfer_python-0.6.17 wheel RECORD (sha256 per file, pinned in RECORD)
entries.notes: P3b (tasks/m23-spec.md P3, N2): the SM120 NVFP4 CUTLASS fused MoE as SGLang runs it (--moe-runner-backend flashinfer_cutlass): FlashInfer csrc with the TensorRT-LLM cutlass_kernels (NVIDIA, Apache-2.0 headers; the cutlass_extensions files carry NVIDIA BSD-3-Clause SPDX headers; NvInferRuntime.h has no header and is covered by the wheel licence). Files are verbatim copies; CCCL comes from the image's CUDA 13.0 toolkit, not from the wheel.
